candidate_policies.description: Default bf16 vLLM baseline with automatic KV-cache dtype.
Default fp16 vLLM baseline with automatic KV-cache dtype.
bf16 model weights with FP8 E4M3 KV cache if supported.

workloads.name: prefill_4k
prompts: Transformer serving systems must manage prompt prefill, autoregressive decode, attention kernels, model-weight layout, and KV-cache storage. Hardware-aware mixed precision can choose different formats for model weights and cached keys and values, but the benefit depends on whether the runtime actually uses efficient kernels and whether quality remains stable. In a long-context workload, KV-cache memory grows with sequence length, number of layers, hidden size, number of KV heads, and dtype width. A lower-precision KV cache should matter most when contexts are long enough that cache allocation and bandwidth become visible in measured latency and memory.
